storeUrls.title: Shopify store URLs
storeUrls.description: Storefront URLs to monitor, e.g. https://www.allbirds.com. Any store built on Shopify works.

trackPrices.title: Track price changes
trackPrices.description: Emit a row when a variant's price moves, with old price, new price and percent change.

trackAvailability.title: Track stock changes
trackAvailability.description: Emit a row when a variant goes out of stock or comes back in stock.

trackNewProducts.title: Track new products
trackNewProducts.description: Emit a row when a product appears in the catalog.

trackRemovedProducts.title: Track removed products
trackRemovedProducts.description: Emit a row when a product disappears from the catalog.

minPriceChangePercent.title: Minimum price change (%)
minPriceChangePercent.description: Ignore price moves smaller than this percentage. 0 = report every change.

maxRows.title: Max change rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on change rows returned. Controls total cost.
